title: Let a change reviewed before its send-back be reviewed again after re-approval
description: Let a change reviewed before its send-back be reviewed again after re-approval
acceptance_criteria: A change that was reviewed, sent back, re-answered, re-approved and re-checked can be reviewed again: `change review` records the new review instead of refusing with `scoped review does not bind a recorded definition approval`, and `change ship`/`finalize` archive it.
The review recorded before the send-back stays in the append-only review history and in committed history, and still validates against the approval it bound; it is never removed or rewritten.

A review recorded before the latest send-back never counts as current: `change status` and `ship-status` report it stale (not unreadable) with the re-review next action, and finalize refuses it, even when the re-approved definition is byte-identical.
A current review must still bind a definition approval recorded after the latest send-back (CHANGE-12.b, REQ-change-123); no gate, bound or timeout is relaxed.
The integration test built from the #914 repro fails on main cd8cab5e at the second review and passes with the fix.

answers.constraints: change lesson (#901/#880): a named recovery is only right once a test runs it, so the repro becomes the failing-first integration test through the binary under workflow v2; CHANGE-12.b/REQ-change-123: a definition approval recorded before the latest send-back never binds a current review; committed review history is append-only and is never removed or rewritten.
